entry.title: Guidance Required End to End Supplier Invoice Automation in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud
entry.content:
Hello Experts,

I am new to the SAP Automation domain and would appreciate your guidance on an end to end Supplier Invoice Automation scenario in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud using SAP Build Process Automation.

I am currently working on a project with the following business requirement :-

  • A supplier invoice is received as an email in Microsoft Outlook.
  • The automation monitors the mailbox and retrieves the incoming email.
  • The attached PDF invoice is downloaded.
  • The invoice data is extracted using SAP Document AI.
  • The extracted data is validated and used to create a Supplier Invoice in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud.
  • After the Supplier Invoice is created successfully, the downloaded PDF should be attached to the created Supplier Invoice as a supporting document.
  • After successful processing, the email is marked as Completed in Outlook.

I have attached the automation flow for reference, which represents the expected business process.

I have already completed the prerequisite configuration, including :-

  • SAP BTP account setup
  • Subscription to SAP Build Process Automation
  • Required communication arrangements in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud
  • Creation of the Supplier Invoice Automation project

At this stage, I need guidance on designing the complete workflow, especially :-

  • Connecting to Outlook and monitoring incoming emails
  • Downloading PDF attachments
  • Configuring SAP Document AI extraction
  • Mapping the extracted fields to the Supplier Invoice API
  • Creating the Supplier Invoice in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud
  • Attaching the downloaded PDF to the created Supplier Invoice
  • Marking as completed or moving it to Complete folder in Outlook

Please find the API details attached for your reference, as this is the API we are using in the automation process.

  • API_SUPPLIERINVOICE_PROCESS_SRV = (Used to create the Supplier Invoice).
  • API_CV_ATTACHMENT_SRV = (Used to attach the supporting document (PDF) to the created Supplier Invoice).

Could anyone share any official documentation, blogs, tutorials, or step by step implementation guides for this complete scenario?

Any guidance or learning resources would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you.

entry.title: SAP BTP ABAP Trial – HTTP 401 on ADT reentranceticket after service instance outage
entry.content:
Hello,

I am experiencing an authentication issue with one specific SAP BTP ABAP Environment Trial instance.

The instance was working correctly until a few days ago, when it became temporarily unavailable. During that period, Eclipse ADT displayed:

"The ABAP Server is in run level 'internal'"

and accessing the service instance URL displayed:

"Service Instance Currently Unavailable"

The instance became available again, but since then I have been unable to authenticate to it.

Current behavior:

  • Eclipse ADT browser-based authentication fails with HTTP 401 – Not Authorized on:
    /sap/bc/adt/core/http/reentranceticket
  • Accessing /ui on the affected ABAP instance displays the classic ABAP login screen (User / Password / Client 100) instead of the usual federated SSO authentication.
  • The issue occurs from two different computers.
  • I have tried creating a new Eclipse workspace and a new ABAP Cloud Project, with the same result.
  • I created a second ABAP Environment Trial instance in the same BTP Trial account. This new instance works correctly from Eclipse ADT using the same user.

Therefore, the issue appears to be specific to the original ABAP Environment instance rather than Eclipse, the browser, or my BTP Trial account.

The affected instance had been working correctly before the service outage.

Is there any way to restore the federated authentication / business user mapping for this ABAP Environment instance?

The instance contains development objects that I need to recover, so I would like to avoid deleting or recreating it.

Thank you for your help.

entry.title: Job Template which developed by the ADT (ABAP Development Tools)platfor can't be selected in the Job
entry.content:
Hi,

  1. In the D  system , In the APP Maintain Application Job Templates , I create the Job Templates A which developed by the ADT (ABAP Development Tools)platfor .
  2. In the D system , In the APP Application Jobs, I click the button create , I can select the Job Templates A  ,the Job can work.
  3. In the D system ,  In the APP Export Software Collection, I have exported it to the Test system .
  4. In the T  system , In the APP Maintain Application Job Templates , I can see the Job Templates  A.
  5. But In the T  system , In the APP Application Jobs, I click the button create , I can’t see the  Job Templates  A.

  6. The error message:

    The ADT-generated IAM apps from the Application Job template have an error in "Input Valid Description." The new version's flawed IAM prevents data migration, causing Business Catalogs to fail referencing the faulty IAM. Consequently, job templates created in the D system cannot be retrieved by program jobs when transferred to the T system.

    Identity and Access Management

entry.title: S/4HANA OData V2 Services Returning HTTP 403 – CSRF Token Validation Failed
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

We are currently facing an issue while accessing S/4HANA OData V2 services from our SAP UI5 applications.

OData Services: Multiple OData V2 services in QRE
Failure Date: 28 September 2026
Approximate Time: From start of day

The applications and OData services were functioning as expected previously. However, from today, requests involving POST / $batch are consistently failing with HTTP 403 Forbidden – CSRF token validation failed.

This issue is not limited to deployment. Existing UI5 applications that were already working are also experiencing the same issue while communicating with the S/4HANA OData V2 services.

Technical Details:

The application successfully fetches the CSRF token using the X-CSRF-Token: Fetch header.

The S/4HANA backend responds successfully with HTTP 200 OK and returns an X-CSRF-Token.

The token returned by the backend is then included in the subsequent request.

However, the subsequent $batch POST request fails with HTTP 403 Forbidden – CSRF token validation failed.

Example request:

POST /sap/opu/odata/sap/<ODATA_SERVICE>/$batch

We have verified from the browser network trace that:

  1. The $batch request is nevertheless rejected with HTTP 403.

Observation:

This issue started suddenly, while the same applications and services were working previously.

The issue is also occurring with multiple existing OData V2 services/applications, so it does not appear to be specific to a particular UI5 application or a new deployment.

We would like to understand whether there have been any recent changes related to:

  • S/4HANA Gateway

  • Any recent system configuration or maintenance

Request your guidance on the possible root cause.

Screenshots of the $batch request/response

Can you please help on this issue.

Thank you.

Problem -> now when event is triggered , i could see in EEE monitor , in OB Events -> 1 message acknowledged for TOPIC1 and then once it goes to the consumption side, my backend consumption classes for ECM_Q1 and ECM_Q2 are getting triggered . however its triggering 2 times for each ECM.

  • i read in internet somewhere that  "The /IWXBE framework, when it reads a message from Q1, looks up the inbound topic TOPIC1 and finds 2 Topic Consumers registered: ECM_Q1 andECM_Q12. It calls both for every queue read — regardless of which queue the message came from.   ??? is this correct  ?
